_meta.title: SCA 认证体系全景
_meta.note: CSP 六大模块课程树 + Q-Grader 独立认证（原 CQI，2025 起 SCA 接管为 Evolved Q Grader，基于 CVA）。Q-Grader 不属于 CSP 模块。

_intro.zh: SCA Coffee Skills Program (CSP) 包含六大模块，每个模块分 Foundation / Intermediate / Professional 三级（Introduction to Coffee 仅有 Foundation）。
_intro.en: SCA Coffee Skills Program (CSP) has six modules; each module has Foundation / Intermediate / Professional levels (Introduction to Coffee has only Foundation).

name.zh: 咖啡入门 Introduction to Coffee

desc.zh: 咖啡产业链全景：从种子到杯。CSP 体系唯一的单级模块，是其余五个模块的推荐前置。
desc.en: Full coffee value chain seed-to-cup. The only single-level module in CSP; recommended prerequisite for the other five.

for_whom.zh: 所有咖啡爱好者与从业者入门
for_whom.en: All enthusiasts and professionals as entry

desc.zh: 意式萃取、奶咖制作、拉花、吧台管理、卫生与工作流。
desc.en: Espresso, milk drinks, latte art, bar management, hygiene & workflow.

desc.zh: 手冲、金杯理论、萃取科学、多器具适配、研磨与水质。
desc.en: Pour-over, golden cup, extraction science, multi-brewer, grind & water.

desc.zh: 杯测、风味轮、感官训练、CVA 评估（含 SCA-102~105）。Q-Grader 的推荐前置。
desc.en: Cupping, flavor wheel, sensory training, CVA (SCA-102~105). Recommended prerequisite for Q-Grader.

desc.zh: 烘焙原理、曲线控制、缺陷识别、拼配、样品烘焙。
desc.en: Roast principles, curve control, defect ID, blending, sample roasting.

for_whom.zh: 想自己烘豆的进阶玩家

desc.zh: 供应链管理、生豆分级、合约与采购、产区认知。
desc.en: Supply chain, green grading, contracts, sourcing, origin knowledge.

_intro.zh: Q-Grader 是独立于 CSP 的咖啡品质鉴定师认证。原由 CQI 颁发，2025 年起 SCA 接管为 Evolved Q Grader，基于新 CVA 体系。详见 qgrader_exams.json。
_intro.en: Q-Grader is a standalone certification independent of CSP. Originally from CQI; since 2025 SCA runs it as Evolved Q Grader, based on the new CVA system. See qgrader_exams.json.

recertification.zh: 3 年内重新认证，含 CVA 更新模块
recertification.en: Re-cert within 3 years incl. CVA updates

name.zh: 原 CQI Q Grader（2024 及以前）

note.zh: 老版基于 100 分杯测体系；2025 后过渡到 CVA。
note.en: Legacy based on 100-pt cupping; transitioned to CVA in 2025.
